campaign: Q2 algebraic manufactured motion, preregistered before candidate runs
domain: logical [0,1]^3, physical x=X+mesh_shear*Y, y=Y, z=Z; closed nonperiodic walls

meshes.coarse_fine: shear .25; isotropically refine logical .375<X<.625 base cells

timestep_policy: global maximum sum of positive owner-oriented incident bulk face rates / native cell volume; fixed dt<=target/rate, split exactly at T/2 and T; no timestep reduction on rejection
oracle: test-local convex polygon clipping/shoelace and exact z-interval overlap; 128-sided polygon is the declared drop, not an approximation silently labelled an analytic circle; arithmetic accuracy gate 5e-12 of initial phase volume by global reference inventory
flux: Stokes line integral of piecewise-polynomial vector potential, six-point Gauss integrated after edge splits at coordinate breakpoints and quadratic roots r^2=.3^2,.45^2. Degree<=8 on each piece. No opposing normal streams hidden in net face volume; analytic sign structure and independent finite-difference normal samples are checked on N16 faces. No production PLIC oracle.
cutoff: Translation: f(s)=8s below1/8,1 on[1/8,7/8],8(1-s) above7/8; g(s)=-3s below1/8,s-.5 core,3(1-s) above7/8. Az=Ux*f(X)*g(Y)-Uy*g(X)*f(Y); genuine3D Ay=.1*g(X)*f(Z). Shear Az=sign*.4*g(Y)^2*f(X), reversal aligned at t=.5. Rotation Az=F(r^2), F=-pi*s for s<=.3^2; for a<s<b F=-pi*[a+(b-a)*(t-t^3+.5t^4)], t=(s-a)/(b-a), a=.3^2,b=.45^2; outside F=-pi*[a+(b-a)/2]. F prime<=0. Closed walls; grid lines include every extension breakpoint and sign reversal. Entire phase trajectory remains in unchanged analytic core.

acceptance.shape: sum absolute cell gas-volume error / initial gas volume, gates above apply to finest GeometricFace result
acceptance.translation_centroid: finest error <=.25 times minimum width among reference or numerical mixed interface cells, physical coordinates
acceptance.spatial_order: log(E32/E64)/log(2)>=.9; no claim of second order
acceptance.fallback: zero required for completed GeometricFace candidates; model, halo and arithmetic rejection remain failed gates
acceptance.limiter: GeometricFace ShearReturn C=.8: at least four accepted steps with active directed-stream theta<1; failure leaves sustained-limiting gate open
acceptance.comparison: DonorCell is conservative low-order comparison, no sharper-interface shape/order gate
acceptance.temporal: complete endpoints and invariants; report errors and differences independently, no assumed temporal order
acceptance.midpoint_checkpoint: Every run/resolution/backend must accept exactly t=.5 as a step endpoint before completing unchanged T=1.
acceptance.rotation_midpoint_excursion: Both backends: initial physical x centroid minus t=.5 physical x centroid >=.15. Exact off-centre full-rotation reference is -.3 x at midpoint; half its displacement in the correct direction is an excursion sanity gate, separate from final accuracy.
acceptance.shear_midpoint_deformation: Both backends: physical xy covariance(t=.5)-covariance(0) >=.25 times the positive exact polygon-moment covariance change; summed absolute cell gas-volume change from independent initial reference at t=.5 >=.25 times independent midpoint-versus-initial reference L1. These 25% lower bounds prove nonzero deformation without imposing GeometricFace sharp-interface accuracy on DonorCell; final shape/order gates remain unchanged.
acceptance.flux_fixture_regression: Always-on N16 all-motions independent finite-difference curl versus analytic derivative, no opposing analytic normal samples per logical face, zero exterior face flux, six-face Stokes closure across cells straddling every coordinate breakpoint/midplane; explicit former X=.5,Y[1/16,1/8] counterexample now u=-.6 and q=-3/80 for unit height.
acceptance.actual_face_regression: Always-on explicit Cartesian, physically affine-skew, oblique-logical-chord, and horizontal native-face vertex witnesses admit each manufactured flow; an oblique radial chord crossing its active zero line rejects with the multistream diagnostic. No mesh build is required for these geometry witnesses.

mesh_providers.uniform: CartesianAMR: root_blocks=(N/2,N/2,nz/2), block_cells=(2,2,2), unit origin/extent, geometrically identical N*N*nz cells; actual cell_box centers select x-stripe owners
mesh_providers.skew_and_coarse_fine: ExtrudedAMR unchanged; actual base-root node logical centers select x-stripe owners. Global XY catalog reconstruction/validation can dominate setup; timed setup rejection/interruption is zero accepted physical time and not a numerical pass.

provider_change_scope: Representation/setup change only: coordinates, resolutions, oracle, timestep/Courant, endpoints, acceptance targets and resource bounds unchanged.
invalidated_fixture_evidence: Earlier cubic-cutoff motion runs are invalid as Q2 qualification evidence because opposing spatial normal streams were collapsed to net face volumes. Zero-step accepted-source Q1 reconstruction snapshots remain valid input diagnostics. Corrected extension preserves exact phase oracle/geometry, N sequence, T=1, gates, and caps.
moment_interpretation: Numerical centroid/covariance/raw moments use the cell-centered piecewise-constant phase distribution; compare against exact physical polygon/prism moments and report sampled-reference errors separately. Initial actual displacement is defined as zero.
actual_face_admission: Before creating controls, every actual native face is unsheared and validated locally. Non-rotation faces must remain within aligned f/g cutoff boxes (Z alignment needed only for genuine3D). Translation normal extrema are affine vertex values. Shear vertical-chord normal is quadratic: interior .25/.5/.75 fit locates its stationary point, and one-sided interior-box endpoint limits are checked. Radial normal sign factor nX*(Y-.5)-nY*(X-.5) is checked on the chord restricted to r<.45. Horizontal normal is zero or affine3D w. Unsupported geometry/alignment rejects; any positive and negative normal values reject explicitly as manufactured fixture requires spatial multistream with face id. No epsilon permits uncertain signs. Generic coarse/fine faces passing conservation alone are not admitted by this check.

optional_phase_cleanup.cumulative_absolute_volume_caps: 1e-13 times each original global phase inventory before initialization cleanup
optional_phase_cleanup.accounting: actual signed, absolute and largest endpoint corrections, event counts; raw/cleaned mass and declared momentum corrections reported separately
optional_phase_cleanup.physical_acceptance: original physical drift includes cleanup; original oracle, endpoints, tolerances, resources and backend identity unchanged
optional_phase_cleanup.support: Ordinary SweptPartition and GeometricFace support cleanup; the qualification switch enables GeometricFace only and DonorCell remains raw. Without the switch controlled fixtures explicitly disable cleanup. Ownership-only migration preserves cleanup state; cleanup-enabled coupled AMR/remap with transported auxiliary channels remains unsupported
